# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Support Ticket Management with Grounded Q&A

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality gate before `/speckit-implement`—RAG grounding, ticket lifecycle, API contracts, search, and cross-artifact consistency (not implementation verification).

**Created**: 2026-09-25

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [technology-requirements.md](../technology-requirements.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Generation context** (no `/speckit-checklist` arguments): **Depth** standard; **Audience** PR reviewer; **Focus** grounded RAG + server-enforced lifecycle, with API/search/traceability cross-checks.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are create, list, detail, update (title/description/priority/assignee), comment, keyword search, and status-filter requirements each traceable to acceptance scenarios or success criteria without orphan FRs? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1–2, FR-001–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 Are optional-at-create and immutability rules for **category** documented consistently across spec, data model, and API contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004a, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Are **resolution notes** capture, edit window, and transition preconditions specified for every status where notes apply or are forbidden? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013a–FR-013b, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements for **searchable ticket knowledge** (fields ingested vs list keyword search) explicitly distinguished so title/category/comment inclusion rules cannot be misread? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006a vs FR-017, TR-001]
- [x] CHK005 Are all prescribed **technology requirements** (TR-001–TR-017) mapped to behavioral FRs/SCs without referencing non-existent requirement IDs? [Completeness, Conflict, technology-requirements.md §Traceability]
- [x] CHK006 Is **tasks.md** (or equivalent bounded implementation task list) defined and aligned with plan phases before implementation starts per constitution Principle V? [Gap, plan.md §Documentation]
- [ ] CHK007 Are UI flows for ticket CRUD, search/filter, status transitions, resolution notes, and ask cited in requirements with pointers to ui-flow or equivalent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023–FR-025, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is **display ticket id** vs **internal surrogate key** unambiguous for persistence, OpenAPI schemas, RAG metadata `ticketId`, keyword search, and **sources**? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-015a]
- [ ] CHK009 Is **case-insensitive substring** keyword search defined for boundaries (empty query, whitespace-only, partial display id, special characters)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006a, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Are **meaningful UI errors** for ticket flows defined with enough specificity to distinguish validation, illegal transition, and infrastructure failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is **honest no-match** ask behavior defined for answer text constraints (template vs paraphrase) without permitting fabricated ticket facts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, rag-api-contract.md §Response 200 no-match]
- [ ] CHK012 Are **top-k** and **similarity threshold** configuration surfaces named (property keys, defaults, valid ranges) in requirements or architecture—not only “configurable”? [Clarity, TR-004, SC-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Is **single retrieval → generate** scope defined to exclude tool chaining, ticket creation, and notifications in both product and API layers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, TR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 Is **re-index / refresh** timing (“updated or closed”) reconciled with ingestion triggers (create, comment, metadata-only updates, CANCELLED)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, rag-ingestion.md §Triggers, TR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do allowed transition lists match exactly across spec, state-machine.md, and planned transition service authority? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, state-machine.md §Allowed transitions]
- [ ] CHK016 Do ask response shapes (**answer**, **sources**, **noMatch**, HTTP success on no-match) align across spec clarifications, technology requirements, rag-api-contract, and OpenAPI? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015b–FR-016, TR-011–TR-012]
- [ ] CHK017 Is plan’s **transaction-boundary re-index** statement consistent with ingestion failure rollback and spec persistence guarantees? [Consistency, plan.md §Summary, rag-ingestion.md §Failure handling]
- [x] CHK018 Are constitution Principle IV grounding/citation rules reflected in spec FRs without weaker wording (e.g., “cite ticket IDs” vs display ids only)? [Consistency, constitution.md §IV, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK019 Does keyword search field scope in spec conflict with any design doc implying title or comments in embeddable text for list search? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006a, rag-ingestion.md §Canonical document]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can SC-001–SC-004 be verified from written requirements alone without inventing unstated UI steps or data setup? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK021 Are SC-005–SC-007 tied to objective signals (cited display ids, noMatch payload, post-update answer content) rather than subjective “grounded” judgment only? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005–SC-007]
- [ ] CHK022 Are engineering evidence requirements (FSM tests, documented AI mistake, no secrets) stated with clear done criteria? [Measurability, TR-015–TR-017, SC-009]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the full **transition matrix** test obligation scoped (all forbidden paths vs representative set) consistently between spec SC-003 and state-machine.md? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, state-machine.md §Test matrix]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are **primary** flows covered for ticket lifecycle including resolution-notes edit while RESOLVED before CLOSE? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3 scenario 10]
- [ ] CHK025 Are **alternate** flows defined for optional category at create and assignee updates affecting metadata only? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004a, rag-ingestion.md §Triggers]
- [ ] CHK026 Are **exception** flows specified for illegal transitions, missing resolution notes, and invalid ask question validation? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, rag-api-contract.md §Errors]
- [ ] CHK027 Are **recovery** requirements defined when embedding/vector insert fails mid-write (user-visible outcome, index consistency)? [Coverage, rag-ingestion.md §Failure handling, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are ask scenarios for illustrative in-scope questions bounded so eval scope is clear without implying exhaustive question catalog? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4 illustrative list]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Are zero-result keyword search and status filter behaviors specified (empty list, no misleading placeholders)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements for resolution-notes edit when status is not RESOLVED explicit (reject except on IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-013b]
- [ ] CHK031 Are terminal-state transition attempts (from CLOSED/CANCELLED) classified as rejected with consistent HTTP semantics across API docs? [Edge Case, state-machine.md §Explicitly forbidden, api-contract.md]
- [ ] CHK032 Is behavior defined when retrieval returns chunks but none pass similarity threshold (no-match vs partial answer)? [Edge Case, rag-api-contract.md §Grounding guard, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Are concurrent ticket updates and ask queries addressed for staleness expectations or explicitly deferred? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-019]

- [x] CHK034 Are performance expectations for ticket UI vs ask latency documented with explicit “no hard SLA in v1” boundaries where plan defers targets? [NFR, plan.md §Performance Goals, Gap]

- [ ] CHK036 Are accessibility or internationalization requirements intentionally excluded or specified for ticket and ask UI? [NFR, Gap, ui-flow.md]
- [ ] CHK037 Is observability (logging, metrics for RAG failures, embedding errors) required or explicitly out of scope? [NFR, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption limiting scope to product sections 4–8.3 validated against what plan and TR artifacts actually cover? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 Are external dependencies (embedding/chat providers, PostgreSQL/pgvector) documented with failure modes affecting ask availability? [Dependency, plan.md §Technical Context, Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 Is ticket **delete** intentionally out of scope everywhere (spec, ingestion deletion note) without contradictory API entries? [Assumption, rag-ingestion.md §Deletion]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
